snapshotMethod: Captured once from the listed canonical constructor inputs. The test reads these literal resolved states, rows, p/g values, scale coordinates, cents, layout axes/probes, chord-v2 outputs and placements; it never reruns a tuner to produce expected values.
independentOracles: Integer dot products of prime-factor exponent vectors with frozen mapping rows check each canonical JI member coordinate.
The EDO case uses integer step count period*31 + generator*18; separate coordinates [0,0] and [-18,31] both have zero 31-EDO steps and remain distinct coordinate identities.
Coordinate cents are checked from the literal dot product period*p + generator*g; frequency is checked by the independent product tonicHz * 2^(period*p/1200) * 2^(generator*g/1200).

Fixed reference ratios use 2^(referencePeriods*p/1200) and the stored ideal rational. The optimized-period case records the same ideal 2/1 but explicitly expects the resolved actual period not to be pure.
Board unwrapped probes are checked from physical staggered geometry and frozen axes; wrapped probes are checked as baseCoordinate + register on the period component exactly once.

fixtures.description: Meantone canonical mapping; explicit 7-note, fifth-rotation mode.
Compatible 31-EDO realization with canonical EDO settings.
400-cent period; three temperament periods equal one 2/1 octave. The 1/1 [0,0] and 5/4 [1,0] members share a period class but differ by one 400-cent period; this is not equal absolute frequency.
Same Meantone mapping with opt-in free-period Weil–Euclidean tuning.

notes: The divided-octave 4:5:6 source retains three exact JI members; v2 reports two period classes and realization.collapsedMembers=1. The collapsed 5/4 member is a one-period displacement from unison, not an equal-frequency duplicate.
Composition material must preserve the selected placed coordinates and source/voicing metadata, even when v2 reports a period-class collapse.
